atoms.text: Pierre shouted, “Bring the sails down!” At last, they had arrived at the Island of Pages. Pierre had been searching for years.
atoms.sound: ssml: Pierre shouted, <voice voice='m1'> “Bring the sails down!” </voice> At last, they had arrived at the Island of Pages. Pierre had been searching for years.

atoms.text: “Captain, should we bring the shovels?” asked his first mate, Marley.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voice='f2'> “Captain, should we bring the shovels?”</voice> asked his first mate, Marley.

atoms.text: “Oh Aye! And the snacks as well, if you please, Ms Marley.” The crew unloaded onto the sand. The search for the Changing Book had begun.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voice='m1'>“Oh eye! And the snacks as well, if you please, Ms Marley.”</voice> The crew unloaded onto the sand. The search for the Changing Book had begun.

atoms.text: The search lasted weeks. They explored the whole island, but still could not find the cave. Pierre was getting frustrated.
atoms.sound: The search lasted weeks. They explored the whole island, but still could not find the cave. Pierre was getting frustrated.

atoms.text: Pierre said, “We searched everywhere! Maybe I read the map wrong,” and sat down on a rock.
atoms.sound: ssml: Pierre said,<voice voice='m1'> “We searched everywhere! Maybe I red the map wrong,”</voice> and sat down on a rock.

atoms.text: Suddenly, the rock began to move. Pierre jumped up and watched as the rock revealed the entrance to a cave!
atoms.sound: ssml: Suddenly, the rock began to move. Pierre jumped up and watched as the rock revealed the entrance to a cave!

atoms.text: There it was, the Changing Book! He had found it! Now he would always have something to read.
atoms.sound: ssml: There it was. <break time='600ms'/>the Changing Book! He had found it! Now he would always have something to read.
